assets.name: MeadowBackground
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONLY the background painting for the BORROWED TIME Unity game menu, landscape 16:10 wide, high resolution. Paint a beautiful softly textured watercolor and gouache fantasy meadow viewed slightly from above, closely matching the provided reference's lush lime-green, soft butter yellow sunlit grass, blue-green moss and deep teal tree canopy shadows. Broad EMPTY grassy clearing across left and center (left 65 percent), open soft surface for a sleeping 3D character to be placed later. Sunbeams and dappled light slant from upper left to lower right. Ground foliage with a few tiny cream wildflowers at perimeter, painterly lively grass brushstrokes, dreamy but not foggy. Rightmost 30 percent remains darker shaded green grass to support cream UI added separately. Detailed grass surface throughout but quiet spacious center. NO text, NO logo, NO buttons or panels, NO people, NO characters, NO animals, NO buildings, NO foreground close-up branches covering center, NO floating leaves baked into the image. Do not include any UI whatsoever. The tree canopy along top edge is background shadow and distant foliage only; close foreground foliage and animated leaves are separate assets.

assets.name: BorrowedTimeLogo
assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: transparent title logo ONLY for a watercolor fantasy game menu. Text verbatim on TWO centered lines: BORROWED on line one, TIME on line two. B-O-R-R-O-W-E-D T-I-M-E. Elegant large decorative storybook hand-drawn serif capitals, creamy pale yellow ivory ink, slightly organic tapered letterforms, clear legible lettering. Wide horizontal logo approximately 3:2 aspect. Surround the title with a thin delicate curling moss-green and ivory vine oval, a few small sage leaves and tiny cream wildflowers with butter-yellow centers. Match the attached BORROWED TIME reference's natural whimsical botanical wordmark. Text occupies most of the asset, flower embellishment modest, no panel behind text, no extra slogans, no other words, no characters, no clock icons, no framed box. Isolated on a genuinely transparent background, no painted scenery, no drop shadow rectangle, no opaque backdrop. Keep all vines and letters away from canvas edge with modest 4% safety margin. Render a finished production logo.

assets.name: BotanicalButton
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one EMPTY fantasy game UI button plaque, isolated on genuinely transparent background. Wide horizontal paper and light wood sign, aspect ratio about 4:1. Soft ivory cream parchment center, subtle watercolor paper grain and butter yellow sunlit edges. Rounded organic irregular corners, a very thin moss green twig border with delicate loosely winding vines. A few tiny ivory five-petal wildflowers and sage leaves at far left and far right corners ONLY, keeping the large center entirely clear for live dark green text and an icon to be added in Unity. Style: charming hand-painted watercolor/gouache botanical game art matching BORROWED TIME meadow menu reference. The sign fills nearly the entire canvas with a small transparent margin; understated slim edges, no chunky wood planks, no rope, no nails, no characters, no objects on center. Absolutely NO TEXT, letters, symbols, button icons, scenery or background. Single plaque only, no sprite sheet, no other buttons.

assets.name: ForegroundFoliage
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent FOREGROUND FOLIAGE overlay layer for a wide 16:10 watercolor fantasy meadow menu. Genuinely transparent background, the entire central 80 percent EMPTY AND TRANSPARENT. Only a softly painted cluster of dark blue-green, teal and moss leaves on thin branches entering the extreme TOP LEFT corner (not across top center), and a smaller blurred blue-green foliage cluster entering extreme BOTTOM LEFT corner. No opaque background anywhere, no scene or ground, no text, no border frame, no objects in right half (right 45 percent completely transparent). Delicate leafy canopy edge treatment, sunlight touching a few yellow-green leaves. Airy sparse composition, foreground depth, painted watercolor/gouache matching the BORROWED TIME meadow reference. Branches must remain only along outer left corners, not across the open grass center. No floating leaves: those are animated separately. No people, animals, buildings, or characters.
